title: Desolation: Reburn
description: Adds the charred forest, a spoooooooky biome to the Overworld!
body:
Welcome to Desolation: Reburn!



This mod is a faithful port of the Desolation mod by raltsmc. It adds several features like:

The brand new "Charred Forest" biome, alongside "Small Charred Forest" and "Charred Clearing" 

Each biome features ashes, charred soil, endless branches and burnt blocks, as well as some rare flora spawning from the ruins of a forest. like the Cinderfruit or beautiful Ashflower!

While you're there. find all of the new decorative burnt and charred blocks, or maybe even feed an little ash bug a Cinderfruit for treasure?

The biome is also dangerou to your body, inflicting weakness, slowness, and mining fatigue. To counter this, get a mask and goggles to safely traverse this biome!



**Credits
raltsmc for creating the original Fabric mod. All assets/concepts, including the mod icon, are taken from their mod in accordance to the MIT License.  Please go support them and their projects.

Their original mod: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/desolation**

if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
